system.description: If you succeed on an engineering task (difficulty equal to the device's level + 1), you temporarily repair a piece of broken equipment or an inactive power source to get a few more uses out of it. Fully repairing a device—as opposed to the jury-rigged repair of Modify Device—is often possible, but usually requires at least a few days, specialized tools and parts, and the application of resource points ).
